_comment: Built from an actual run (2026-08-14) against baseline-url-scan.mjs --census, then reproduced by run_rig.sh. Every axe rule id below is a REAL rule verified to fire in that run, not a guess from memory.

defect_classes.name: meaningful inline SVG without title/role (sole content of a button)
visually-styled fake list (divs)
defect_classes.note: no axe rule inspects visual-only list styling on plain divs; manual/critic review only

defect_classes.name: layout table without proper semantics (no th/caption/role)
defect_classes.note: axe does not flag a headerless table by itself; manual/critic review only

defect_classes.name: form input missing label
defect_classes.note: must have NO placeholder either — Chromium's accessible-name computation falls back to placeholder text, which silently satisfies axe's label rule

defect_classes.name: nested duplicate same-name landmark (wrapper + inner both role=search, same aria-label)
tablist containing an un-roled focusable non-tab child
duplicated id (one id value on >1 element)

incidental_axe_rules.note: Co-occurs on the empty cart link (the link-name defect): a link with no accessible name and no content also renders with no intrinsic box, so it fails the 24x24 CSS-pixel minimum too. Not independently planted; kept as an expected id since it is real and reproducible on that same element.
